temporal_scenarios.description: Stationary object with minor jitter (<35px) remains CONFIRMED_PRESENT without movement transitions.
Object spatially displaced by 120px (>35px threshold) triggers CONFIRMED_MOVED with recorded displacement.
Newly introduced object in the scene initializes in CONFIRMED_PRESENT.
Absence on consecutive reliable visits progresses from PENDING_REMOVAL to CONFIRMED_REMOVED.
Single missed detection does NOT trigger false removal; recovers cleanly on redetection.
temporal_scenarios.expected_outcome: Remains PENDING_REMOVAL during occlusion, restored to CONFIRMED_PRESENT.

temporal_scenarios.description: An object previously marked CONFIRMED_REMOVED that reappears is restored to CONFIRMED_PRESENT.
temporal_scenarios.expected_outcome: Restores entity to CONFIRMED_PRESENT while preserving history.

temporal_scenarios.description: Projective transformation maps bounding boxes reliably into canonical space under camera shifts.
temporal_scenarios.expected_outcome: Valid canonical bounding box preserved across viewpoint shift.

temporal_scenarios.description: Conservative cross-class association links identical spatial positions across fluctuating detector labels without duplicate identities.
temporal_scenarios.expected_outcome: Exactly 1 persistent entity maintained across 3 visits.

temporal_scenarios.description: Failed registration strictly halts absence accumulation and spatial updating; blocks false removals.
